# Relationship Map

## Link Inventory

A vault may contain backlinks, relation labels, graph terms, folder groupings, and many explicit links without yet becoming easy to navigate. Listing those structures is useful, but navigation quality depends on whether the connections actually help a person move from one idea to another.

## Navigational Use

This note explains how separate notes become easier to navigate when recurring ideas are tied together through explicit references and meaningful connections. Its focus is building a map of related concepts so a person can move across notes by idea instead of folder naming, exact wording, or isolated local labels.

## Connection Maintenance

Useful relationship maps are curated. They keep a few strong paths visible, connect notes that share conceptual weight, and avoid turning every weak mention into noise. The point is navigability across the vault, not merely recording that links exist.
